assumptions.statement: Overall design and key-area polygons are provisional_rough organizer substitutes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics and maps must be recomputed after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Station halls, platforms, landmarks, and phasing are conceptual urban-design suggestions for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: No demolition, investment, approval, or engineering-feasibility claims are made.

assumptions.statement: Metric areas are computed after projecting WGS84 polygons to EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: Small residual topology differences may appear if another projection is used.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, road redlines, and rail control lines are not in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Those controls remain unknown and must not be invented.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used as planning-language transfer, not as licensed image or trademark reuse.
assumptions.impact: No case photos or logos are embedded; only named textual transfer is kept.
